description.value: Aidan's Coffee & Food is a neighbourhood café with two Vancouver outposts, the Broadway location tucked into unit 111 of an office building at the edge of Fairview. The full espresso bar runs alongside grab-and-go wraps, sandwiches, and a rotating pastry selection — with online pickup ordering so cyclists can have food ready before they dismount. The menu leans toward quick, satisfying options that suit riders on a daytime schedule.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (20 spaces, covered) at 18m. Total: 20 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the W Broadway location at 805 W Broadway #111, Vancouver is active with online ordering via Square and a full menu of espresso drinks, pastries, grab-and-go items, and lunch. Takeout is explicitly supported ('Order your favorites and skip the line' pickup system). The website shows a postal code of V5Z 1H2 while OSM records V5Z 1K1 — a discrepancy flagged below. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere on the site.
concerns: Postal code mismatch: OSM records V5Z 1K1 but website shows V5Z 1H2 for the W Broadway location.
OSM has no phone number; phone (604) 318-2794 sourced from website only — contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
Two different email addresses listed on website for the two locations (aidanscafe@gmail.com for W Hastings; aidanscafe@icloud.com for W Broadway); no email in OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active café with a confirmed website, online ordering system, and two operating Vancouver locations. Straightforwardly useful to touring cyclists for food and coffee.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes Chickpea Guacamole Wrap and Yogurt Parfait as vegetarian options; no explicit vegan or GF labelling found
